summary: Check Point Harmony Endpoint Complete: all the endpoint protection of Advanced plus disk and USB encryption.
value: Malware and ransomware are stopped, and encrypted files are restored.
Data on a lost laptop or USB stick cannot be read without the key.
Phishing is blocked in the browser, and suspicious files are checked in a sandbox.
simple: Protects computers and servers (Windows, macOS, Linux, VDI) with a single agent, managed from the cloud or on premises. Blocks malware, ransomware (with recovery of encrypted files), exploits, communication between infected machines and attacker servers (Anti-Bot), and fileless attacks by behavior; uses Check Point ThreatCloud threat intelligence and its own indicators of compromise. Automatically collects forensic data and builds an attack report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and lets you hunt for threats. Includes a host firewall, USB port and device control, application control, a check that the computer complies with policies, and a VPN client for remote access. In the browser, it blocks phishing sites, including brand-new ones (Zero Phishing), filters URLs, turns on safe search and doesn’t let employees enter a corporate password on a third-party site. Checks suspicious downloaded files in a sandbox (Threat Emulation) and immediately hands back a cleaned copy (Threat Extraction). Encrypts computer disks and removable media. Posture Management, DLP and XDR are purchased separately.
notIncluded: Vulnerability management, DLP and SOAR are in Elite (in Complete only as add-ons).
classification: Encryption maps to the disk and USB encryption class (created for Harmony).
